% --- Objective ---
\section{\faBullseye \ Objective}
\small{Transition from Technical Trainer to Software Developer within 12 months while working full-time[cite: 148]. Strategy focuses on mastering DSA and the MERN stack[cite: 149]. Long-term target is to scale from 4 LPA to 20 LPA within 5 years[cite: 150].}

% --- Learning Phases ---
\section{\faRoute \ 12-Month Learning Phases}
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{X X}
    \phaseCard{Phase 1: Foundations (Months 1-3)}{
        DSA: Complexity, Arrays, Strings, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues[cite: 155, 156]. \\
        JS: Closures, Promises, Async-Await, Event Loop[cite: 157]. \\
        \textbf{Target:} Solve 100+ DSA problems[cite: 158].
    } & 
    \phaseCard{Phase 2: MERN Mastery (Months 4-6)}{
        Frontend: Hooks, Context API, Performance Optimization[cite: 164, 165]. \\
        Backend: Middleware, MVC Architecture, API Security[cite: 166]. \\
        DB: Aggregation Pipelines, Indexing, Modeling[cite: 167].
    } \\
    \phaseCard{Phase 3: Scaling (Months 7-9)}{
        Backend: Redis Caching, Rate Limiting, Background Jobs[cite: 159, 160]. \\
        DevOps: Docker, CI-CD Pipelines, Cloud Deployment[cite: 161].
    } & 
    \phaseCard{Phase 4: Design and AI (Months 10-12)}{
        System Design: Load Balancing, Microservices, Caching[cite: 168, 169]. \\
        AI: OpenAI API, AI-powered Web Apps, Chatbots[cite: 170].
    }
\end{tabularx}
